name: Collection Manager
overview: Visual metadata-driven native collection creation for Jellyfin.
description: Private-testing build for Jellyfin 10.11.11. Creates ordinary Jellyfin collections from existing tags, providers, networks, genres, people, studios, years, local NFO fields, and other scanned metadata.

versions.changelog: Manual collection Select All and Select None now affect only the ten visible choices on the current page, including its first picker. Paging uses the standard Previous Page and Next Page controls without changing the dashboard scroll position. Logo Focused Art Settings is now in the second tab row; Multi-Collection Gradient Art remains in the third.
